scene: The glowing pod pulses, unlocking three subterranean transit gates ahead.
picture: Pixel art flat side view of vault transit hall. On the left sits a leafy garden tram. In the centre waits an open retro streetcar. To the right rests a bento express train. Pushing his plant-filled bicycle between them stands the grandfather in apron, glowing pod tucked securely into his basket.
